title: The Inspector's Question
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
ciphertext: “YM ERBAB CKI ZTYKE ET QRYGR ITL QTLHN QYMR ET NACQ SI CEEBKEYTK?” “ET ERB GLAYTLM YKGYNBKE TO ERB NTF YK ERB KYFRE-EYSB.” “ERB NTF NYN KTERYKF YK ERB KYFRE-EYSB.” “ERCE QCM ERB GLAYTLM YKGYNBKE.”
plaintext: “Is there any point to which you would wish to draw my attention?” “To the curious incident of the dog in the night-time.” “The dog did nothing in the night-time.” “That was the curious incident.”
epilogue: Inspector Gregory asks the question; Holmes gives the answer. A champion racehorse has vanished from a Dartmoor stable, and the guard dog never barked. A dog that stays quiet at midnight knows the person leading the horse away.
